findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 14 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: Property (iii) is printed as \underline{u} + \underline{0} = \underline{0}. Adding the zero vector leaves a vector unchanged, so it should read \underline{u} + \underline{0} = \underline{u} (Additive Identity), exactly as the book's own proof of (iii) below concludes.
